title: Willow Grove subdivision
goal: Show four serviced lots, roads, setbacks, and utility easement.

rubric.must: Four distinct labelled lots are visibly enclosed within the tract.
Willow Grove Drive and Cedar Lane visibly cross between the lots.
Front and rear setbacks are visibly labelled inside Lot 1.
A continuous 10 ft utility easement is visibly marked through the subdivision.
North arrow, scale, and overall dimension are visible.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the siteplan exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target visibly shows four enclosed, individually labelled lots; both named roads cross between them; Lot 1 has labelled front and rear setbacks; a continuous utility easement runs through the subdivision; and the north arrow, graphic scale, and overall dimension are visible. No material overlap or cropping blocks interpretation.

items.evidence: Lots 1–4 are individually labelled and enclosed within the tract boundary.
Willow Grove Drive crosses horizontally between the lot rows, and Cedar Lane crosses vertically between the lot columns; both are labelled.
Lot 1 contains labelled 25 ft front and 20 ft rear setback lines.
A continuous, labelled 10 ft utility easement runs north–south through the subdivision.
The 300 ft overall dimension, graphic scale, and north arrow are visible.
